pages.title: 국민안전24 | 행동요령 | 국민행동요령

observation.method: Independent anonymous headless Chromium public-source observation with actual CDP accessibility snapshots, safe original DOM ancestry and fixed sibling/heading context. No engine, implementation or evaluation results read or run.
conditions: Fresh anonymous ko-KR context; headless Chromium; DOMContentLoaded plus 1600ms
Only GET/HEAD network methods allowed; no input values read, text entry, authentication, form submission, download activation, destructive action or business action
All selected source controls had nonzero layout boxes and were not CSS-hidden, inert or aria-hidden
Source task focus/hit-test and three safe public destination GET checks are recorded in docs/evidence/run003/blind-v5-observations.json.
limitations: Small selected-control reconstructions, no full-page layout, source CSS/media or application scripts. Original selected-control labels, href/target, ancestor tags/classes/IDs and nearby fixed context are retained.
Source visible checks establish nonzero boxes and absence of CSS hiding/inert/aria-hidden; only one designated task control per page received read-only focus and center hit testing.

Source accessibility is actual Chromium AX data, and Playwright ariaSnapshot is additionally stored where its selector injection works. NL uses a CDP isolated world due a source-page conflict in Playwright selector injection. No site security, authentication or certificate settings were changed.

task.instruction: 가을철 주요재난에서 태풍 행동요령 원본 링크 위치를 찾으세요. JavaScript 링크를 활성화하거나 검색을 실행하지 않습니다.
task.boundary: public link or original control reach only; no form submit

notes: 계절별 주요재난 영역의 여섯 실제 주제 제어를 모두 선정했다. 각각의 안전 행동요령 안내는 help이다. 원본 JavaScript URL은 보존하되 실행하지 않으며 locate로 주석했다.

Fixture base href resolves original relative public hrefs against the observed source URL. Original JavaScript hrefs are inert under script-src none; original event implementations are omitted. No actual user input values or authenticated content are included.
